decls.name: Prop36ChebotarevApplication

paper_span.quote: \(q_1,\ldots,q_t\) which split completely in the normal closure over \(\mathbb Q\) of \(E(i)\). For each such prime

decls.rationale: Proposition 3.6 (Chebotarev application): after excluding a finite set, there are `t` distinct rational primes splitting completely in the normal closure of \(E(i)\); each satisfies \(q_b \equiv 1 \pmod 4\), splits completely in `F`, and has a Frobenius representative in \(\Phi(G)\) at every prime above it.
